subject: MATHEMATICS
description: Disciplinary ontology, representations, and validation invariants for Grade 9-11 Mathematics (CBSE, JEE Main, JEE Advanced, IOQM).

FOUNDATION.name: CBSE_BOARD
FOUNDATION.target: Axiomatic Euclidean geometry, algebraic identities, quadratic formula, basic coordinate geometry, trigonometric ratios, arithmetic progressions.

STANDARD.name: JEE_MAINS
STANDARD.target: Analytical geometry of conics, complex numbers representation, polynomial roots relations, sequences and series summation, binomial theorem, trigonometric equations.

RESEARCH.name: JEE_ADVANCED_IOQM
RESEARCH.target: Rigorous olympiad/advanced proofs, extremal principle, invariant theory, combinatorial configurations, functional equations, diophantine equations, transformation matrices.

epistemological_rules: Strictly distinguish axiomatic definitions from derived theorems; circular proof dependencies are forbidden.
Counterexamples must explicitly state domain violations (e.g. division by zero, non-invertible domains).
Every geometric or analytical assertion must state validity domains (e.g. x in R, x > 0, non-degenerate triangle).
Never substitute heuristic numerical verification for formal deductive proof.
